integrity: The relative-phase identity, invariant three-dimensional phase leaves, variational block splitting, and divergence sums are derived analytically. Exact polynomial identities are replayed by a dependency-free checker embedded with this result. No finite simulation is used as proof, and the primary source equation, publication date, and first-listed MSC classification were checked directly in the accessible article.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the ordinary integer-order system reproduced in Section 2.1 of the primary source, not to its Caputo fractional-order extension. The Lyapunov conclusion concerns non-equilibrium compact ergodic invariant measures and asymptotic exponents; it does not exclude transient finite-time estimates with two positive values. The 2008 introducing article was not available as verified full text during this check, so an unindexed equivalent phase reduction there remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact phase locking excludes hyperchaos in a five-dimensional complex flow
